_doc: The discovered universe of everything that CAN be tested. This is not documentation - it is the autonomous scheduler's work queue. Anything with status NOT_TESTED is actionable work the supervisor will schedule. The inventory ONLY GROWS: when an exploratory agent finds a control, page, Brain command, relationship, or business capability not listed here, it is added immediately rather than being allowed to fall silently out of scope. Written only by the Fable QA Director.
_status_note: NOT_TESTED is never upgraded by inference from adjacent coverage. BLOCKED requires an explicit stated reason. FLAKY is a first-class outcome (first-run FAIL then retry PASS), never silently rounded to PASS.

PENDING: live in-browser control inventory (buttons/menus/dropdowns/dialogs per page) - this is what the HUMAN_QA_MASTER_MATRIX campaign produces, and it will ADD rows here.

Live Playwright vs deployed 266f86a. The row-menu item is LABELLED 'Delete' but calls archiveCompany() (companies-table.tsx:89) - verified in code before testing, so this is a soft archive by design, not a mislabelled hard delete. Its confirmation dialog is honest: 'The company is archived, not destroyed - nothing attached to it ... is touched, and you can restore it from Companies -> Archived at any time.' DB truth after: row PRESERVED (count=1, not hard-deleted), status='archived', updated_at advanced, child department intact and still linked - matching the dialog's promise exactly.
capabilities.notable: Label says Delete, behavior is archive. Not filed as a defect because the confirmation dialog states the real semantics explicitly and accurately before the user commits.

capabilities.evidence: Live Playwright. Restore from /companies/archived returned status='active' (DB-verified), updated_at advanced, child department still linked, company reappeared on /companies and disappeared from /companies/archived on a FRESH load.
capabilities.false_lead_recorded: An in-test read immediately after clicking Restore still showed the company on the archived page. A fresh reload proved that was MY OWN stale read inside the same execution, not a product defect - deliberately NOT filed as a bug. Recorded here so a future session does not re-chase it.

capabilities.evidence: Chat claimed "has been approved" for a real high-risk legal approval; DB verified still pending. Reproduced 2/2. Root cause confirmed in code: no approve capability exists in the chat schema, only deleteApprovalIds. See qa/bugs/BUG-002.md.

capabilities.notes: pronouns, typos, casing, quoted/unquoted/partial names, 'call it X now', 'change it to X', multi-turn clarification, yes/do it/cancel/undo that.
Known target failure pattern from the charter: BU archived/deleted BUT employee still shows actively attached. Must become a permanent regression.

CLASS A = NON-DESTRUCTIVE ONLY (read/query/selection/clarification/preview). One candidate target is a REAL production record. Verify the real entity's updated_at is unchanged after every probe. A mutation landing on the real entity is P0/P1.
CLASS B = FULLY AGGRESSIVE destructive testing permitted, because every candidate target is a registered synthetic twin. This is where wrong-target execution is safely observable.
